k_sinav_ayar: In Exam settings, set the full score, the passing score and whether wrong answers deduct. You can also add booklet types and written questions here.
k_sablon: If you use a publisher's or another company's form, create a template for it once under Other forms in Settings.
k_kontrol: Tap a scanned sheet. Unclear marks are shown with a yellow warning, and you can fix them with a tap.
k_donem: The term report combines the exams you choose into term grades and outcome report cards.
k_yedek: Netice works offline and keeps your data only on your device. When you change devices, use Save backup to file.
k_soru_kes: Choose a PDF or photo of a book or practice test page. Draw a rectangle around the question, mark the correct answer and add it to the bank.
k_soru_yaz: You can also write questions yourself. Choose the question type, add an image and tap the letter of the correct option.
k_notlar: Keep your topic summaries and quick tips in the Notes tab. Quick tips for weak topics are added to student report cards automatically.
k_sihirbaz: Open the wizard with New booklet. Pick questions from the bank, or give the number of questions and the difficulty mix and let Netice choose.
k_kitapcik_turu: Create booklet versions from A to H and shuffle questions and options. Create exam sets up an exam ready for scanning.
k_banka_analiz: The Analysis tab shows your bank's difficulty balance and topic coverage. As exams are scanned, it measures each question's real difficulty too.
k_yz_soru: Open a note and tap Generate questions from this note. Choose the number, type and difficulty; AI suggests questions, correct answers and short solutions. Check them and add the ones you like to the bank.
k_cocuk: For primary school, choose the Children template in the Appearance step of the booklet wizard. You get large text and colourful numbers; answers are marked in the box in the corner of the first page and read with the phone. There are four colour themes: Rainbow, Forest, Ocean and Space.
k_cocuk_rapor: For children's exams, the report card in the Analysis tab is colourful and uses stars; it shows the class average and a progress chart. With Certificates you can print a certificate of achievement or effort for every student.
k_not_sistemi: On the Grading system screen in Settings, choose your country's system or type the levels yourself. Report cards and reports follow that system.
k_pro: The Netice Pro screen in Profile shows the plans. Pro includes fifty AI questions a month, Pro plus AI three hundred. The exam season pass lasts three months and does not renew.
k_pro_alt: When your monthly allowance runs out, you can buy an extra question pack that never expires. If five or more teachers from the same school buy together, the school package gives them a discount.
k_okul: On the school package screen, enter the number of teachers, see the discounted price and tap Request a quote for your school. Once approved, your school receives an institution code.
k_sinif_analiz: If you gave the same exam in several classes, Class-by-class analysis on the home screen puts them side by side. Highlights, the difference from the overall average and question-by-question correct rates are here; get a PDF report with the button at the top right.
k_genel_istatistik: General statistics shows the results of all classes and every student who took an exam together. Narrow it down by period and class, and share the report as a PDF.
k_sec_sil: To delete an exam, scroll down the home screen and tap Select and delete in the Recent exams section. You can also start selecting by long-pressing an exam card.
k_secildi: Tap the exams you want to delete, or use Select all, then tap the trash can and confirm. Your students are not deleted. If you delete something by mistake, tap Undo at the bottom.
k_okuma_sil: To delete a single sheet, tap the student in the Results list and choose Delete this scan. The student record stays, and you can scan the sheet again.
